name: Off Grid AI
description: Desktop app for local chat with text and vision models, image generation, speech-to-text and text-to-speech, plus a local OpenAI-compatible API.
compatibility: Runs GGUF models from a built-in catalog or Hugging Face search through bundled llama.cpp, image models through stable-diffusion.cpp, transcription through whisper.cpp and speech through Kokoro.
Serves chat, vision, images, transcription, speech and embeddings on an OpenAI-compatible API at http://127.0.0.1:7878/v1 with no key, and can run as a headless gateway without the UI.
Adds Model Context Protocol servers (no auth, token or OAuth) as tools inside chat.
limitations: Release builds cover macOS on Apple Silicon, Windows x64 and Linux x64 (Ubuntu 24.04 or newer).
Model downloads come from Hugging Face; the app checks for signed updates. Anonymous usage data and crash reports are sent only if the user turns them on.
The local API has no authentication and listens on loopback.
An optional paid Pro layer (screen memory, meetings, dictation, clipboard) lives in a separate private package; the Linux build does not include it.

sources.note: Bundled engines, model catalog and Hugging Face search, Gateway endpoints and headless mode, MCP connectors, opt-in analytics, auto-update, supported platforms and the separate Pro package.
